_comment: Synthetic Mujina accounts for the JIP POC (design §4, §18). Local development only. The binding attribute name is a govroam placeholder (design §10). DEZI numbers refer to the mock DEZI provider's fixtures (mock-dezi/fixtures/profiles.yaml).

jip-anna.description: Valid number of mock person anna (one profile, role 01.000); also used with mock person frank for a number mismatch

jip-bram.description: Valid number of mock person bram (two profiles: profile selection)

jip-carla.description: Valid number of mock person carla (profile without a role code)

jip-dirk.description: Valid number of mock person dirk (role code 00.000)

jip-eva.description: Valid number of mock person eva (revoked statement)

jip-nonumber.description: No binding attribute: JIP skips DEZI

jip-empty.description: One empty value: JIP skips DEZI

jip-spaces.description: A raw SAML value of only spaces: EngineBlock's parser trims it to empty, so JIP skips DEZI (design §4)

jip-multi.description: Two values: malformed, JIP fails the login

jip-forged.description: Sends a value under a reserved DEZI name: JIP fails the login (reserved_attribute)
